title: AlphaProteo: AI-designed protein binders
summary: A system for designing high-affinity protein binders, tested against seven targets, achieved 88% laboratory success on BHRF1 and bindings 3 to 300 times stronger than the best existing methods. It produced no valid binders for TNFα; strong binding is only a first step.

evidence.tested: Binders were designed against seven target proteins and tested in the lab, with 3 to 300 times stronger binding and higher experimental success rates than the best existing methods.
evidence.unknown: Per-target success rates are not given on the abstract page and no limitations are listed.
evidence.ai_role: A family of machine learning models for protein design that generates the binders.
